messages:
Noah (People Ops): Quick heads-up: Were running a final compliance sweep for SOC2/ISO evidence and privacy training. Two small asks: 1) complete the 15-min privacy refresher by 2026-04-07; 2) upload or link control artifacts by 2026-04-12.
Sara (Security): To add : for teams with live prod services wereally need access logs (last 90 days), ACL snapshots, and the on-call rota. If you canrexport these automatically, paste the path.
Ethan (Eng Manager): Managers: we also need a short attestation (one-sentence) confirming team artifacts are complete. Where do we sign off?
Maya (Compliance): Ethan : attestation is a checkbox in the evidence form + a one-line note field. Link: <https://redwood-internal/forms/compliance-evidence|evidence form>. Managers should tick before the artifact deadline.
Ravi (Infra): FYI our infra scripts push CSVs nightly to s3://redwood-compliance/infra-exports/prod. Ilell paste the example path in the form.
Noah (People Ops): We will sample 10% of artifacts for deep review; if yours is sampled wereach out with a quick review task. Please respond within 48h to avoid follow-ups.
Ethan (Eng Manager): Understood. If a team member already uploaded last quarter stuff, should we re-upload if nothing changed?
Maya (Compliance): Reuse is fine if the artifact covers the required timeframe. Add a short note saying "reused: Q4-2025 export" and confirm dates.
Sara (Security): Small formatting thing: name your uploads with the control ID prefix (e.g., IAM-02_access-matrix.csv). Makes reviewer life easier.
Noah (People Ops): Office hours this Wed 9:30am & Thu 4pm in #people-ops-help for quick checks. Pop in with one artifact and well confirm good to go.
ci-bot: Scheduled job: evidence-ingest-checker -> runs daily at 02:00 UTC, will flag missing metadata :white_check_mark: (informational)
Ethan (Eng Manager): Thanks : will nudge my team. Also will request a short extension for two folks on call this week if needed.
Noah (People Ops): Extensions allowed but please request via the form with reason + manager sign-off. Werestrict to exceptional cases.
Ravi (Infra): Uploaded: INF-07_access-exports, INF-08-kv-cache-config (s3 paths included).
Maya (Compliance): Got the uploads, adding to tracker. Expect sampling email if selected.
Noah (People Ops): TL;DR: privacy training by 2026-04-07, evidence by 2026-04-12, manager attestation in the form, office hours Wed/Thu. Ping @Noah or @Maya for questions. :pray:
Ethan (Eng Manager): Uploaded: IAM-03, OT-02 (attested).
Sara (Security): Beginning lightweight reviews today. If anything missing wereach out in thread.
Noah (People Ops): Appreciate the quick responses : helps us hit audit timelines.
